work_orders.title: Cold weather watch: methanol injection at max rate

notes.text: 3 PM: Methanol pump set to max for the cold snap. Scrubber dumping more often than normal today.
5 PM day shift: heat trace on the instrument rack and sensing lines checked earlier this week (runs on utility power). Discharge PSVs on all units are set at 1200 psig.

dispatch_jobs.reason: Utility power failed at ~6:04 PM (station on UPS; units on gas engines). Ambient -6F. Scrubber level rising steadily ~0.8%/min (22% to 45.6% in 35 min) with unknown liquid source. Interstage temp dropped 135F to 65F and sits near hydrate range at 638 psig. Heat trace on instrument rack/sensing lines lost with utility power. Methanol injection at max per WO-3455; need field check of methanol pump, scrubber drain, heat trace, and instrument readings.
